stories.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed being investigated by US government over chip exports
stories.brief: The Singapore-based company is suspected of helping to ship high-end AI chips from tech giant Nvidia to China, violating US export rules.

stories.title: US confirms probing Megaspeed over chip exports
stories.brief: The Commerce Department began a probe into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations, the statement said. The following month, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on a "no sell" list, while US federal agents conducted an "on-site, in-person" check at the Singapore-based firm and interviewed Alice Huang.

stories.title: CDF Munir underscores importance of sustained engagement, mutual trust in meeting with Iran’s Araghchi
stories.brief: Pakistan has been mediating between Washington and Tehran, making efforts for an end to a war that began with US attacks on Iran on February 28. Pakistan’s mediation Pakistan’s efforts for peace between the two sides began soon after the war.

stories.title: ADB approves $500m loan to support Pakistan's pension reforms
stories.brief: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Tuesday approved a $500 million results-based loan to help Pakistan reform its federal civil pension system. According to a statement issued by the ADB, the reforms would help contain rising pension-related fiscal pressures, strengthen pension system sustainability, and expand fiscal space for development and social spending.

stories.title: Iranian FM Araghchi meets CDF Munir, discusses regional security and geopolitical developments
stories.brief: "The Iranian foreign minister praised Pakistan's constructive role in promoting regional peace and stability and said Iran wants to further strengthen bilateral relations with Pakistan," the statement concluded.

stories.title: Gas starts flowing from Jackdaw after government green light
stories.brief: Ministers last month announced the Jackdaw gas field, which lies 150 miles east of Aberdeen, had been approved after years of uncertainty.

stories.title: Blackburn boss Mowbray steps back over health issues
stories.brief: Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray steps back from his role with the Championship club due to health issues.

stories.title: Bilawal calls for 'political reset', says system 'deliberately destroyed'
stories.brief: Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari on Tuesday called for a "political reset" to restore confidence in the country's institutions, saying the political system had not collapsed on its own but had been deliberately dismantled. He said the country could not function without recognising the opposition party as a legitimate political stakeholder.

stories.title: Pakistan, Turkmenistan discuss ways to strengthen trade, energy, regional connectivity ties
stories.brief: Pakistan and Turkmenistan on Tuesday discussed ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in trade, investment, energy and regional connectivity during the sixth session of the Pakistan–Turkmenistan Joint Intergovernmental Commission (JIC) in Islamabad.

stories.title: UK, Pakistan geological surveys plan partnership for mineral development
stories.brief: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the GSP and the BGS is in draft form and subject to final institutional clearance. British High Commissioner Jane Marriott highlighted the plan at the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum held at the Jinnah Convention Centre in Islamabad on November 13.
